correctness.rationale: Retaining the optimal Bézout coefficient in the inner-parallel and chord arguments gives the stated normalized bounds; the covariogram layer-cake identity and polar integration then yield the explicit difference-body estimate, which combines directly with Böröczky's Rogers--Shephard stability theorem.

originality.rationale: The unit-coefficient simplex characterization and Rogers--Shephard stability are prior art and are not claimed as new. Targeted searches found no prior quantitative bridge from the optimal two-body Bézout coefficient to the Rogers--Shephard deficit or the resulting explicit Banach--Mazur stability bound.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a newly completed qualitative characterization to a global affine stability theorem and supplies explicit intermediate inradius, chord, and difference-body inequalities.
